[RLOW.8.1.2] **Backend selection.** The compiler selects backings as
[RDSC.5a.2] states, from [LSER.18.1]'s matrix, and emits one backend atom per
(backing, window), each carrying the window of the observation line it serves
([RDSC.5a.8.1]). The author never names a backing. A line with no exact
backing is refused before lowering ([LSER.15.2]). A declaration no lowered rule
reads emits no backend atom.
